test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 12 May, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: In which of the following articles, "Right against Exploitation" are mentioned?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Article 23 - 24.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Right against Exploitation** is a **fundamental right **enshrined in the Indian Constitution, which** prohibits trafficking, forced labor, and child labor.**<
